editorialNotes: The central question and sequence follow the seven reviewed source sections. The measured frame example uses an original 60-frame motion: contact at 15, active window 15–19, control at 42 and idle at 60. Numbers shown belong to the demo, not the observed games. Great sword replaces the hammer opener with the same visible residual motion.
